in_hebrew.name: חרה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: A name derived from the Hebrew word חרה (charah), meaning mountainous, rocky, rough. This name is not found in the Bible.

in_greek.name: Ἅρα
in_greek.long_meaning: The Greek name Ἅρα (Hara) has a different meaning from the Hebrew origin. It is derived from the Greek word ἁγελία (hagelia), meaning harvest. This name is not found in the Bible.

in_latin.name: Hara
in_latin.long_meaning: The Latin name Hara is derived from the Latin word harus, meaning rock, mountain, or rough. This name is not found in the Bible.
